criteria.contract: Prefer active accepted duties, movement and custody over discretionary work. Use only own observed inspection need and own completed/received results; select bounded personal practice during idle time with deterministic own-ability preference, not hidden third-party values.

criteria.contract: Run practice as an ordinary 30-minute self-task, at most once per day, and credit only actual completed time. Do not mint resources, rank, offices or relationships. Newly actionable outside duty interrupts discretionary practice through the existing task contract.
criteria.title: 共通の修行仕事・実完了経験・用件による中断

criteria.contract: Persist reconstructible decision inputs, stable identities and priorities. Prevent repeated work each tick, duplicate awards and changes caused by unknown road conditions; the same input must choose the same action.
criteria.title: 判断入力・識別子の保存と重複防止
